### Serpent on a Pole - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/serpent-on-a-pole-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-29.html
Passage: Numbers 21:8-9
Points:
- Frustrated by journey hardships, the Israelites grumbled against Moses and God's miraculous food.
- Stung by venomous serpents, the people acknowledged their sin and asked Moses to pray for them.
- Healing came to anyone who looked at the bronze serpent in obedient faith toward God's promise.
- Over time the Israelites turned the bronze serpent into an idol, worshiping the object rather than God.
- Jesus referenced this wilderness event to reveal how His own lifting up grants eternal life.

### Snakebite - One Year Devotions for Women
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/snakebite-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-24.html
Passage: Numbers 21:7
Points:
- Discontent and impatience led the Israelites to complain against their leaders and reject God's gracious provision.
- God sent venomous snakes as judgment, leading the people to confess their sin and request intercession.
- Although God provided the bronze serpent for healing, the judgment highlighted the seriousness of grumbling.
- Persistent complaining is habit-forming and spiritually toxic in the everyday life of a believer.
- Christians are called to put away grumbling, even when enduring difficult, desert-like circumstances.
